title: Market-anchored prior - the measured blend weight, and why the market half is blocked
verdict: PARTIAL - the weighting rule is implemented and the weight is MEASURED out of sample; the market application is BLOCKED because no closing line exists for this repository and no NBA-operated source publishes a priced market.
blend_formula: p_anchor = w * p_other + (1 - w) * p_model, w measured by out-of-sample log-loss

corpus.what: every graded game in the walk-forward record that carries both probabilities
corpus.why_not_the_v2_horizon: data/derived/horizon_lines_v2.json covers 2026-11-15..19 and only its 11/15 games have finished; a weight measured on six games is not a measurement. The 60-game out-of-sample record is.

logloss_weights.anchor_identity_used_here: the naive reference probability p_home_ref carried on every backtest row: the same official ratings with the fitted extras removed. It is the only second probability this repository holds for these games, and it stands in for a market price in the ARITHMETIC only - not in the claim.

published_reconciliation.note: The recomputation is from the per-game p_home_model / p_home_ref rows in docs/data/backtest.json; agreement to four decimals means the blend below is measured on exactly the corpus the published log-losses describe.

logloss_weights.reading: If improvement_significant_at_5pct is false, the honest statement is that anchoring to this second source buys no log-loss improvement that the sample can detect, so the weight applied today must be 0 (pure model) until it does. It is published either way, and the same function is what would run against a real closing line.

logloss_identity.statement: For a binary outcome y and a forecast p, Brier = (p-y)^2 and log-loss = -[y ln p + (1-y) ln(1-p)]. Both are proper scoring rules and both are minimised at the true probability, but they are NOT affine images of each other: Brier is quadratic in p, log-loss is logarithmic. A blend weight optimised for one is therefore not, in general, optimal for the other.
logloss_identity.withdrawn_claim: An earlier draft of this file asserted that Brier and log-loss rank linear blends identically. That claim is false and was withdrawn before publication; the two weights below are reported separately because they really are different numbers.

market_anchor.why: The pre-registration files state 'No licensed two-sided price exists (no odds feed)'; no file under data/ holds a two-sided price; and the only hosts this project may read for evidence are the NBA's own, which do not publish priced markets.

required_schema.source_name: the licensed feed's name (must be named on the site)
required_schema.source_url: the URL the price was read from
required_schema.retrieved_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the capture

markets.closing_spread_home: the close, home-perspective, signed (negative = home favoured)
markets.closing_total: the close on the game total
markets.capture_is_pre_tip: true only if retrieved_utc precedes the official tip

what_would_unblock_it.rule_once_present: Refuse any market row whose capture_is_pre_tip is not true or whose retrieved_utc is after the official tip; convert the close to a probability with the measured sigma_margin in model_report_v2.json; then re-measure w on the enlarged out-of-sample corpus. w is never set by hand.

market_anchor.refusal: `--market` exits 5 when the closing-line file is absent. The script will not synthesise, scrape or infer a price.

sources: https://www.nba.com/games (official finals behind every graded game)
